page.overview:
Who is Malva?

Malva is a member of Kalos's Elite Four. She is also a news reporter for the Holo Caster and a former member of Team Flare. She is the -type Elite Four trainer.

Malva has slightly tanned skin and a pink hair with a ponytail and curls on her shoulders. Her eyes are hidden behind a pair of red-shaded sunglasses. She wears a black turtleneck that cuts off just above her belly button and red and black jeans with several diamond shaped cut outs at the front revealing some parts of her legs, as well as black high-heeled shoes.

Malva is an ill-tempered and self-absorbed person. She will scoff rudely at the player upon entering the halls of the Kalos Elite Four, and when defeated she will pout and claim that she wishes to harm the player, whom she hypocritically calls "wicked". However, Malva reveals that she abandoned Team Flare as she was disgusted by how Xerosic was using Emma as Essentia and even teamed up with the player to stop him. Nonetheless, she still made constant threats to burn them, it is unknown if she was just joking about that.

The name Malva comes from "magma", "lava", and "mal-" (a prefix meaning "bad," as she was formerly a member of Team Flare). It could also come from Malva, a genus of plants. Her name may also be a reference to malva pudding, a South African baked dessert.
